cause:eight-downs-are-not-eight-separate.text: Eight downs are not eight separate events: one episode, restarted every ~2,000 ticks because the harness leaves RM_SwimExhaustion at 1 and the pawn in place.

cause:leaving-out-builds-a-collection-ra.text: Leaving out Builds a collection ran in does not steady the slice bound: a collection ran in ~42 of ~75 Builds, and a 36.8 ms Build had none.

cause:not-a-regression-from-round-2-b60a.text: Not a regression from round 2 (b60a1526a4): the wave3 13.6 ms build was an all-reused rebuild inside a 480-build storm, so it was never comparable to a planned build.

cause:not-pit-pathing-no-pit-exists-on-t.text: Not pit pathing: no pit exists on the map (the script digs nothing, excavatedCellCount 0), and RM_PitPathing/RM_PitStepCost act only on cells with ClimbDepthAt > 0.

cause:oracle-production-tap-clamp-mismat.text: Oracle/production tap-clamp mismatch: a re-read of current code found FreshPieces already sets opt.StraightPlugIds = CordWorldAdapter.TapIds(map), for both fresh and sameframe. No reproduction was attempted.

cause:probe-uses-the-power-range-for-pip.text: Probe uses the power range for pipe poles: a re-read of current code found the probe's :plan branch and the gizmo both call CompAerialAnchor.AutoLinkPairs, which groups by kind and uses AerialLineProfiles.RangeFor. No reproduction was attempted.

cause:round-3-s-claim-that-the-solar-pan.text: Round 3's claim that the solar panels were on no net was wrong: vanilla PowerConnectionMaker links a connector to the nearest transmitting conduit within a 13x13 box and draws its wire to connectParent. Round 4 then found SolarGenerator has transmitsPower=true, so the 6-cell search does not apply

cause:the-07-42z-live-fail-was-a-harness.text: The 07:42Z live FAIL was a harness fault, not the mod: proof ran under WSL python3 and raised RimBridgeError (no route to Windows loopback 127.0.0.1:5174), measuring nothing.

cause:the-1-4x-bar-applies-to-every-cord.text: Option (b), that the 1.4 ratio was never meant for a 2-cell lead, was ruled out by the owner: the 1.4x bar applies to every cord and the fix is in the mod.

cause:the-8-ms-budget-at-15b1b2a51080-di.text: The 8 ms budget at 15b1b2a51080 did not bound the whole slice: it limited only edge laying. GraphInputs (whole-map), the layLock/StartGraph hand-off and the map component's snapshot and tail still ran on the main thread outside it, so slice was 25.8 ms >= 20 on live.

cause:the-86-ms-slice-at-site-b-lamps.text: The 86 ms slice at site B lamps was not a GSS phase: it also froze the lay worker (LayEdge 91 ms), so it was a process-wide pause.

cause:the-86-ms-slice-in-round-8-was.text: The 86 ms slice in round 8 was not a GSS phase: it froze the lay worker too (LayEdge 91 ms), so it was a process-wide pause.

cause:the-allfix-lamp-cord-regression-wa.text: The allfix lamp-cord regression was caused by the whole-lead ease catching the lamp's 6.7-cell cord to a strip socket 0.62 away, whose cable tie then dropped the seat.

cause:the-build-phase-does-not-grow-with.text: The build phase does not grow with cords: its max stayed 1.7-4.0 ms from 1 to 8 lattices.

cause:the-calm-v1-v2-site-was-not-the.text: The calm v1->v2 site was not the cause, and neither was a GSS change since 2026-10-16; the cause was FlowWorks being co-loaded (deep swim).

cause:the-claim-that-link-s-runof-traver.text: The claim that Link's RunOf traverses not-yet-processed spans is not true of current code: RunOf already excludes other queued spans via IsPendingSpan.

cause:the-claim-that-seeds-join-only-lai.text: The claim that seeds join only laid-piece endpoints is not true of current code: ComputeNetSeeds already unions hidden connections via Graph.HiddenLinks.

cause:the-earlier-92-unforced-was-not-re.text: The earlier '92 unforced' was not reproduced by the committed Diag.cs; it came from an earlier seed set (174 at the parent kernel, 115 at 6f8bfb47c4).

cause:the-later-a1-fail-theory-that-the-.text: The later A1 fail theory that the pool fix still breaks 20 ms was untested: the built sha touched no GSS file, nothing was deployed, and A1 ran on a 28-mod game without GSS.

cause:the-pool-fix-still-breaks-20-ms-un.text: False theory: the pool fix still breaks 20 ms (untested, proof never reached GSS).

cause:the-r9-44-6-ms-first-slice-outlier.text: The r9 44.6 ms first-slice outlier was not a GC pause or worker stall: gap 0.006 ms, gc0/1/2 0/0/0, lay and graph workers idle. It was snapClone 20.5 + tail 14.8 + snapPower 5.6 + build 3.2.
